Entries.Text: Reload the world in the running game from your save, without going to the title screen. Save your maps first: the game loads them from the game files.
The connection to the running game. It is shared with the Material Editor's Material Reloader and the Text Editor's FMG Reloader.
Saves, then loads the same save again. Loading the world again reads the maps from the game files.
Loads the game's last save again, without saving first. Loading the world again reads the maps from the game files.
The game link is busy with another tool: a material or text reload, or a quit out.
